newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse Friday seen focused on small issues.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse Friday seen focused on small issues.

text.p: Most Polish large cap stocks were seen flat on Friday, following Thursday's mixed post-fixing continuous trade but analysts said speculative buying of second-tier stocks could push the index up.
Only the largest 22 stocks out of 73 issues listed on Warsaw's main market trade in the continuous system.
Analysts said the recent growth of smaller and less liquid stocks combined with mixed performance of larger issues signalled weak institutional demand which could push the market lower next week.
